title: Sibte Nabi ka Matam
body:
sibte nabi ka matam manshoor e zindagi hai
matam hi zindagi hai matam hi bandagi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
daaghe yateemi de ke mujhko kahan gaye ho
maqtal mein ek bacchi baba ko dhoondti hai
matam hi zindagi hai matam hi bandagi hai
sibte nabi ka matam...
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas ne ye keh kar izne jehad maanga
mujhse na dekhi jaaye bacchon ki tashnagi hai
matam hi zindagi hai matam hi bandagi hai
sibte nabi ka matam...
<<DIVIDER>>
bakshish ki zimmedari uski batool par hai
shabbir bewatan ka jo shaks matami hai
matam hi zindagi hai matam hi bandagi hai
sibte nabi ka matam...
<<DIVIDER>>
naame hussain ko na koi mita sakega
ghar baar ko luta ke zainab ye keh rahi hai
matam hi zindagi hai matam hi bandagi hai
sibte nabi ka matam...
<<DIVIDER>>
leke ameer asghar haathon pe shaah bole
ya rab qubool karna fidya ye aakhri hai
matam hi zindagi hai matam hi bandagi hai
sibte nabi ka matam...
author: Ameer Hussain Mashadi
